title: Armstrong Whitworth A.W. 52 G glider prototype on grass, March 1945 (Fig. 5)
description: Photograph, printed sideways on the page, of the A.W. 52 G tailless glider prototype parked on grass, viewed from behind a large wingtip fin. Inscription in the image reads "A.W. 52 G (PROTOTYPE)" with a March date. Captioned "Fig. 5" in a USAF report section on British tailless aircraft designs.
